implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired audit using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the hosted model gpt-5-mini via the openai_responses provider. For each of the 150 preregistered items: (a) run one baseline generation call (direct_configuration_generation_v1); (b) run the guarded pipeline (generate_validate_repair_v1) reusing the shared_initial_candidate when supported, with at most one deterministic repair call if the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 verifier fails. All validation and scoring are deterministic via the adapter's verifier; no human labour is used. Fixed seeds govern sampling, replacements, and augmentation. All model calls, validator logs, and artifacts are cached and hashed for publication.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic sampling script with fixed seed selects 150 items across the preregistered datasets (50 per dataset where available). Excluded high-confidence contaminated items are deterministically replaced using preregistered augmentation seeds; replacements preserve item IDs when possible.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (single-shot). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 implementing deterministic high-confidence holdout, deterministic retemplating, topology-complexity augmentation, intent-preservation embedding check (cosine ≥0.85), and a single verifier-driven repair call per task when needed.
execution_batches: batch-1: tasks 1-150 run sequentially; each task executes up to 2 model calls (baseline then guarded pipeline)
randomisation_plan: All randomisation uses fixed published seed(s) (seed=42) for item selection, deterministic replacements, and augmentation parameters.
caching_plan: Cache all model prompts/responses, verifier outputs, transformation artifacts, and hashes locally; reuse cached artifacts for analysis and rechecks to avoid additional model calls.
failure_recovery_plan: On model/API failure: one automated retry within 5 minutes. If retry fails, record failure, mark the pair per preregistered missingness_plan (complete_pair_primary), and include the pair in sensitivity analysis where failed-call outcomes are treated as failures. All failures logged with timestamps and provider error codes.
result_schema: Each paired_binary_episode_v1 record contains: task_id, dataset_id, condition (baseline|guarded), model_provider, model_name, model_version, seed, prompt, raw_model_output, normalized_output, verifier_pass (bool), verifier_log, model_call_id, timestamp, and SHA256 hashes of raw outputs and verifier logs.
estimated_compute_notes: Total planned hosted model calls = 150 items × 2 variants = 300 calls. This equals estimated_model_calls (300) and maximum_model_calls (300). All calls use hosted_model_api_available capability; no local GPU is required. Wall-clock execution expected well under the 7-day maximum given sequential batching and minimal reasoning effort.
